ops.text: Vendor owns its generic tools and know-how. The revocable, non-transferable, and Order Form term limitations on Customer's Deliverable licence in Section 14.2 do not apply, and Customer's licence to each Deliverable is perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, and royalty-free, and Customer may use, modify, and sublicense each Deliverable for its business.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] Rather than rewrite 14.2, we have added a short 14.2A that leaves Vendor owning its generic tools and know-how but makes our Deliverables licence perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free and usable, modifiable and sublicensable for our business, disapplying only the revocable, non-transferable and Order Form term limitations in Section 14.2. This is our fallback position on ownership of deliverables; our preferred position remains Customer ownership with assignment if Vendor prefers to revisit 14.2.
proposal.summary: Add 14.2A: Vendor keeps generic tools and know-how; Customer's Deliverables licence becomes perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, modifiable and sublicensable
